figurative_meaning_en: Opportunity to gain benefits from others' labor
similar_in_english: Reap where one has not sown
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে ফাঁকতালে অনেক লাভ করলো, কোনো পরিশ্রম না করে।
ব্যবসায়ে ফাঁকতাল ধরে সে সম্পদ অর্জন করেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He gained a lot in the gap, without any effort.
He amassed wealth in business by catching the gap.
note: Refers to benefiting in the 'gap' of rhythm, metaphorically like clapping off-beat to gain without full participation
